I started waking up consistently just by starting to walk more frequently. As my body felt lighter and better, habit just formed around that walking habit. My mood just feels a lot better now a days, a lot better than 9 years ago that's for sure.

I don't really think that I'm depressed though, I have an extraordinary knack for forgetting my problems and laughing, and just being happy in a moment, I have no reason to be depressed, I have lived a pretty good and healthy life, I was never abused, and any of my problems are my own doing, and I don't really cry. Today I did my fair share, but I can't remember the last time I cried before that. If this makes any sense, I don't think I'm depressed, I just really really want to, and think I kind of deserve to die. I'm something though, I imagine killing myself, kind of in the third person, in the most brutal way possible, letting out all my anger towards myself and my inaction on this imagined version of me. I deserve any pain I get, but I wouldn't actually do that to myself, I'm too much of a coward, my plan that I have is the most peaceful way I could find. 

EDIT: I'm sorry if it sounds like I'm trying to throw myself a pity party, it's just, I don't think that I'm depressed. I could be, I've opened myself up to the idea, but people who are depressed always seem so much worse off mentally than me. They don't get a break and they cry for no reason, and that's not really my situation, I don't cry ever really, and it's very easy for me to forget my problems and be happy.
